warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.
Cold-water pipework in PVC class 13.5, the heavier wall SN-01 specifies for potable water. Two sizes: ø3/4" 49 m and ø1/2" 10 m.

*** THE PIPE SIZES DISAGREE WITH SN-06's RISER DIAGRAM ON ONE POINT: SN-06 shows the riser to the second floor as ø1"CW, and SN-04/SN-05 tag ø1"CW(UP) on both floors -- but NO ø1" pipe is priced anywhere in this BOQ. *** Only ø3/4" and ø1/2" appear. Either the ø1" riser has been absorbed into the ø3/4" quantity or it is omitted. Flagged; it is a genuine drawing-to-BOQ discrepancy, not a reading error.

*** THE VALVE COUNTS ARE THE MOST USEFUL DATA HERE and they trace back to SN-02's specification: 2 STOP VALVES at ø1/2" (SN-02 clause 2.4 requires one at every fixture branch -- cistern WC, basin, bidet spray, sink), 7 GATE VALVES and 1 CHECK VALVE at ø3/4". SN-02 requires all of them to be not less than Class 125 and rated 50% above working pressure; the BOQ gives no class, so that requirement lives only in the specification. ***

ONLY 2 STOP VALVES ARE PRICED, WHICH LOOKS LOW against SN-02's 'ทุกจุด' (every point) and A-29's 'ติดตั้ง STOP VALVE ... สำหรับน้ำดีเข้าสุขภัณฑ์ทุกจุด'. With 2 WCs, 2 basins, 2 showers and a sink there are at least 7 supply points. Flagged as a probable under-measure rather than corrected.

The BOOSTER PUMP is priced as one lump 'ชุด' with no performance figures -- SN-04 sizes it (min 200 W, min 28 l/min at 12 m head, FUJIKA/HITACHI/MITSUBISHI). The BOQ cannot be priced correctly without SN-04.

*** THE WATER METER LINE INCLUDES THE UTILITY FEE -- 'มิเตอร์ ขนาด 1/2" พร้อมค่าธรรมเนียม'. *** That is SN-02 clause 1.8.1 and SN-04's plan note made into a priced item: the meter and its connection charge are the contractor's cost.
The FLOAT VALVE at ø1/2" matches the one in the stainless storage tank on SN-04 and SN-06 exactly.
